Each card shows what JOID draws, with a link to the page that teaches it and to its reference.

## Nodes

The nodes that draw shapes, text, images, media, charts and 3D models, and the nodes that arrange other nodes.

## Controls

Text fields draw themselves; the other controls are abstract and need a skin.
These cards use plain skins like the ones that [Give your controls a look](/use/learn/going-further/ui-kit/) writes.

## Effects

Effects change how a node is drawn, never its layout.

<div class="joid-catalog">
<figure class="joid-card">
<img src="/captures/catalog-effects-roundednodeeffect.webp" alt="A blue rectangle with rounded corners" loading="lazy" width="364" height="324" />
<figcaption><a href="/reference/effects/roundednodeeffect/"><code>RoundedNodeEffect</code></a><span>Rounds the corners of what a node draws, all four or only some of them.</span><small><a href="/use/learn/style-and-motion/effects/">Learn</a> · <a href="/reference/effects/roundednodeeffect/">Reference</a></small></figcaption>
</figure>
<figure class="joid-card">
<img src="/captures/catalog-effects-circlenodeeffect.webp" alt="A blue square cut into a disc" loading="lazy" width="364" height="324" />
<figcaption><a href="/reference/effects/circlenodeeffect/"><code>CircleNodeEffect</code></a><span>Cuts what a node draws to the largest disc centered in its bounds.</span><small><a href="/use/learn/style-and-motion/effects/">Learn</a> · <a href="/reference/effects/circlenodeeffect/">Reference</a></small></figcaption>
</figure>
<figure class="joid-card">
<img src="/captures/catalog-effects-bordernodeeffect.webp" alt="A dark grey rectangle with a thick blue border" loading="lazy" width="364" height="324" />
<figcaption><a href="/reference/effects/bordernodeeffect/"><code>BorderNodeEffect</code></a><span>Outlines the pixels that a node draws, outside or inside their edge.</span><small><a href="/use/learn/style-and-motion/effects/">Learn</a> · <a href="/reference/effects/bordernodeeffect/">Reference</a></small></figcaption>
</figure>
<figure class="joid-card">
<img src="/captures/catalog-effects-shadownodeeffect.webp" alt="A dark grey rectangle casting a soft blue shadow below it" loading="lazy" width="364" height="324" />
<figcaption><a href="/reference/effects/shadownodeeffect/"><code>ShadowNodeEffect</code></a><span>Draws a soft shadow of the shape of a node under it, or a glow when the color is light.</span><small><a href="/use/learn/style-and-motion/effects/">Learn</a> · <a href="/reference/effects/shadownodeeffect/">Reference</a></small></figcaption>
</figure>
<figure class="joid-card">
<img src="/captures/catalog-effects-blurnodeeffect.webp" alt="The placeholder image, blurred" loading="lazy" width="364" height="324" />
<figcaption><a href="/reference/effects/blurnodeeffect/"><code>BlurNodeEffect</code></a><span>Blurs what a node draws with a horizontal then a vertical Gaussian pass.</span><small><a href="/use/learn/style-and-motion/effects/">Learn</a> · <a href="/reference/effects/blurnodeeffect/">Reference</a></small></figcaption>
</figure>
<figure class="joid-card">
<img src="/captures/catalog-effects-masknodeeffect.webp" alt="A dark grey frame with a blue outline marks the bounds of a node; the mask keeps only a blue to light grey gradient window in its middle" loading="lazy" width="364" height="324" />
<figcaption><a href="/reference/effects/masknodeeffect/"><code>MaskNodeEffect</code></a><span>Hides every pixel of a node and its children outside a rectangle, or outside the opaque part of an image.</span><small><a href="/use/learn/style-and-motion/effects/">Learn</a> · <a href="/reference/effects/masknodeeffect/">Reference</a></small></figcaption>
</figure>
<figure class="joid-card">
<img src="/captures/catalog-effects-transformnodeeffect.webp" alt="A blue rectangle rotated by 20 degrees" loading="lazy" width="364" height="324" />
<figcaption><a href="/reference/effects/transformnodeeffect/"><code>TransformNodeEffect</code></a><span>Moves, rotates or scales the drawing of a node and its children without changing the layout.</span><small><a href="/use/learn/style-and-motion/effects/">Learn</a> · <a href="/reference/effects/transformnodeeffect/">Reference</a></small></figcaption>
</figure>
</div>

## Transitions

A transition animates a UI when it opens and when it closes.

<div class="joid-catalog">
<figure class="joid-card">
<button type="button" class="joid-film" aria-pressed="false" data-film="/captures/catalog-transitions-poptransition.webp" data-still="/captures/catalog-transitions-poptransition.still.webp"><picture><source srcset="/captures/catalog-transitions-poptransition.still.webp" media="(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)" /><img src="/captures/catalog-transitions-poptransition.webp" alt="The pointer clicks Open on a dark card: a popup grows into view over it, stays open, then shrinks away when Escape closes it" loading="lazy" width="364" height="324" /></picture><span class="joid-film-state">Pause the animation</span></button>
<figcaption><a href="/reference/ui/poptransition/"><code>PopTransition</code></a><span>Transition that grows a UI from 75 % of its size when it opens and shrinks it back when it closes, in 130 ms, around its anchor.</span><small><a href="/use/learn/style-and-motion/transitions/">Learn</a> · <a href="/reference/ui/poptransition/">Reference</a></small></figcaption>
</figure>
</div>

## Text effects, markup and modifiers

Text effects move or color each glyph: JOID ships the `ITextEffect` interface, and the effects and the markup of these cards are written like the ones in [Text markup and effects](/use/learn/describing-the-ui/text-markup-and-effects/).
Text modifiers change the characters before layout.

## Cursors

The cursor shapes a node asks for with `cursor(...)`; the operating system draws them, so their look follows the system, and each card shows a plain drawing of the shape.
[Hover, tooltips and cursors](/use/learn/interactivity/hover-and-tooltips/#change-the-cursor-over-a-node) shows how a node asks for one.
